instructor: Asst. Prof. Dr. Ali Fahim Ni'ma
subject: 04_Advanced_Software_Eng
topic: The Spiral Model and Risk-Driven Development

questions.question: The Spiral Model was developed by...
options: Barry Boehm proposed Spiral in 1986
Victor Basili proposed Spiral in 1986
Bev Littlewood proposed Spiral in 1986
Roger Pressman proposed Spiral in 1986
options_en: Barry Boehm proposed Spiral in 1986
Victor Basili proposed Spiral in 1986
Bev Littlewood proposed Spiral in 1986
Roger Pressman proposed Spiral in 1986
options_ar: قدم باري بوم نموذج Spiral عام 1986
questions.explanation: Barry Boehm published the spiral model in 1986 to bring risk analysis into the process.
questions.explanation_ar: نشر باري بوم النموذج الحلزوني عام 1986 ليدخل تحليل المخاطر في العملية.

questions.question: Which model organizes each development loop around explicit risk analysis?
questions.question_ar: أي نموذج ينظم كل دورة تطوير حول تحليل واضح للمخاطر؟
options: Spiral considers project risk in every loop.
Waterfall considers project risk at each phase.
Prototyping considers project risk during evaluation.
Iterative Enhancement considers risk across releases.
options_en: Spiral considers project risk in every loop.
Waterfall considers project risk at each phase.
Prototyping considers project risk during evaluation.
Iterative Enhancement considers risk across releases.
options_ar: يراعي Spiral مخاطر المشروع في كل دورة.
يراعي الشلال مخاطر المشروع في كل مرحلة.
تراعي النمذجة الأولية المخاطر أثناء التقييم.
يراعي التحسين التكراري المخاطر عبر الإصدارات.
questions.explanation: The Spiral Model makes risk identification and resolution a central activity in each loop. The other models are organized around staged development, requirements feedback, or successive enhancement.
questions.explanation_ar: يجعل Spiral تحديد المخاطر ومعالجتها نشاطاً محورياً في كل دورة. أما النماذج الأخرى فتتمحور حول المراحل أو تغذية المتطلبات الراجعة أو التحسين المتتابع.

questions.question: How can a prototype help during Spiral risk analysis?
questions.question_ar: كيف يمكن للنموذج الأولي أن يساعد في تحليل مخاطر Spiral؟
options: Performance management guides decisions in each loop.
Efficiency management guides decisions in each loop.
Risk management guides decisions in each loop.
Quality management guides decisions in each loop.
options_en: Performance management guides decisions in each loop.
Efficiency management guides decisions in each loop.
Risk management guides decisions in each loop.
Quality management guides decisions in each loop.
options_ar: إدارة الأداء توجه قرارات كل دورة.
إدارة الكفاءة توجه قرارات كل دورة.
إدارة المخاطر توجه قرارات كل دورة.
إدارة الجودة توجه قرارات كل دورة.
questions.explanation: A prototype can be used to investigate an alternative and resolve uncertainty before committing to full development. It does not eliminate risk analysis or guarantee stable requirements.
questions.explanation_ar: يمكن استخدام نموذج أولي لفحص بديل وتقليل عدم اليقين قبل الالتزام بالتطوير الكامل. لكنه لا يلغي تحليل المخاطر ولا يضمن ثبات المتطلبات.

questions.question: Which four activities form the Spiral Model's recurring sectors?
questions.question_ar: ما الأنشطة الأربعة التي تكوّن قطاعات النموذج الحلزوني المتكررة؟
options: Requirements, design, coding, and maintenance.
Business, data, process, and application modeling.
Inception, elaboration, construction, and transition.
Planning, risk analysis, development, and assessment.
options_en: Requirements, design, coding, and maintenance.
Business, data, process, and application modeling.
Inception, elaboration, construction, and transition.
Planning, risk analysis, development, and assessment.
questions.explanation: Each cycle includes planning, risk analysis, development, and customer assessment. The other lists belong to different process structures.
questions.explanation_ar: تتضمن كل دورة التخطيط وتحليل المخاطر والتطوير وتقييم العميل. أما القوائم الأخرى فتنتمي إلى هياكل عمليات مختلفة.

questions.question: What does each spiral loop begin with?
options: setting the next-loop objectives
closing the project after delivery
writing code before risk review
testing a release after planning
options_en: setting the next-loop objectives
closing the project after delivery
writing code before risk review
testing a release after planning
questions.explanation: Objectives for the next increment are fixed before any risk work starts.
questions.explanation_ar: أهداف الدفعة التالية تُحدَّد قبل أي عمل على المخاطر.

questions.question: After the increment is reviewed, what closes each loop?
questions.question_ar: بعد مراجعة الدفعة، ماذا يغلق كل دورة؟
options: Deploy the completed product to users.
Review the result and plan the next loop.
Disband the team after the final release.
Sign a contract to start the next phase.
options_en: Deploy the completed product to users.
Review the result and plan the next loop.
Disband the team after the final release.
Sign a contract to start the next phase.
questions.explanation: The customer reviews the result and the next loop is planned from it.
questions.explanation_ar: العميل يراجع النتيجة وتُخطَّط الدورة التالية منها.

questions.question: For which projects is the spiral model best suited?
questions.question_ar: لأي مشاريع يناسب النموذج الحلزوني أكثر؟
options: projects with a stable fixed scope
projects with no customer involvement
large projects with substantial risks
small projects with little risk
options_en: projects with a stable fixed scope
projects with no customer involvement
large projects with substantial risks
small projects with little risk
questions.explanation: The risk loop pays off when the project is big enough for risk to matter.
questions.explanation_ar: دورة المخاطر تستحق عندما يكون المشروع كبيراً بحيث تهمّ المخاطر.

questions.question: What do the Spiral Model's radial and angular dimensions represent?
questions.question_ar: ماذا يمثل البعدان الشعاعي والزاوي في النموذج الحلزوني؟
options: Team size and number of user requirements.
Risk probability and number of software modules.
Elapsed time and the project acceptance score.
Cumulative cost and progress through each cycle.
options_en: Team size and number of user requirements.
Risk probability and number of software modules.
Elapsed time and the project acceptance score.
Cumulative cost and progress through each cycle.
options_ar: الكلفة التراكمية والتقدم في كل دورة.
questions.explanation: The radial dimension represents cumulative cost, while the angular dimension represents progress in completing each cycle.
questions.explanation_ar: يمثل البعد الشعاعي الكلفة التراكمية، بينما يمثل البعد الزاوي التقدم في إكمال كل دورة.

questions.question: Why can the Spiral Model be viewed as a metamodel?
questions.question_ar: لماذا يمكن اعتبار النموذج الحلزوني نموذجاً فوقياً؟
options: It can accommodate different process models based on risk.
It prescribes one fixed sequence for every project.
It removes planning and assessment from development.
It applies only to throw-away user-interface prototypes.
options_en: It can accommodate different process models based on risk.
It prescribes one fixed sequence for every project.
It removes planning and assessment from development.
It applies only to throw-away user-interface prototypes.
options_ar: يفرض تسلسلاً ثابتاً واحداً لكل مشروع.
يقتصر على نماذج واجهة أولية تُهمل.
questions.explanation: The Spiral Model provides a risk-guided framework that can accommodate another development model, such as Waterfall or Evolutionary Development.
questions.explanation_ar: يوفر النموذج الحلزوني إطاراً موجهاً بالمخاطر يمكنه استيعاب نموذج تطوير آخر مثل الشلال أو التطوير التطوري.

questions.question: What capability does effective Spiral use depend on?
questions.question_ar: على أي قدرة يعتمد الاستخدام الفعال للنموذج الحلزوني؟
options: Eliminating alternatives before planning.
Competent assessment of project risks.
Complete avoidance of customer evaluation.
A single frozen requirements document.
options_en: Eliminating alternatives before planning.
Competent assessment of project risks.
Complete avoidance of customer evaluation.
A single frozen requirements document.
questions.explanation: The model relies on risk-assessment expertise; weak assessment can undermine decisions about alternatives and risk resolution.
questions.explanation_ar: يعتمد النموذج على خبرة تقييم المخاطر؛ وقد يضعف التقييم غير الكفء قرارات البدائل ومعالجة المخاطر.
